notes: Long history article; the early bouts are listed in prose, so each is its own entry with a shared excerpt. Several dates and numbers are garbled (duration, round counts, 'Rotter' Island'), and each is flagged in the entry. Some claims are inferred from garbled text (the Ohio arrest day, the Cincinnati departure date, the benefit date), and their confidence is marked low or medium. The Hogan challenge, the Joe Coburn match and the seconds are only in part from this article.
